external_roms.purpose: Freely licensed third-party Game Boy images loaded over UART; verified against this pin before any byte is transmitted
external_roms.storage: Fetched at run time into the host's shared cache <cache>/<name>/ (N2M_EXTERNAL_ROM_CACHE, else the per-user default outside every checkout), which earlier ignored workdir/private/external-roms/<name>/ caches seed; no image bytes are committed
external_roms.redistribution: No image or notice is copied into this repository; each entry keeps its upstream terms
external_roms.fields: Each images entry records url (https), sha256, size (exactly the image size of the pin's profile), optional profile (a package profile name; absent means dmg-direct-v1, dmg-mbc1-v1 marks a 64 KiB MBC1 image that only `host load --external` carries: the flash library keeps 32 KiB slots), license, and optional notices as name -> {url, sha256, size}; title (upper-case letters, digits, space and dash, at most 16) is the catalogue title used only when the image header title bytes 0x134-0x143 are all zero; descriptive keys (name, author, source, release, commit, cartridge, redistribution) identify the reviewed release and say when the artifact is a third-party redistribution rather than the author's own release

verilator.license: LGPL-3.0-only OR Artistic-2.0; see upstream LICENSE, LICENSES/ and the SPDX header in every source file
verilator.purpose: Supported Linux RTL simulator, built from source by `tools verilator`; the Ubuntu 24.04 distribution package (5.020) is below cocotb's 5.036 minimum
verilator.pinned: 5.052 is upstream's current release as of this pin (#601, 2026-09-15) and the oldest one this repository has validated; cocotb 2.1.0 requires 5.036 or newer, so neither the Ubuntu 24.04 package (5.020) nor any earlier tag qualifies. Raise it only with a fresh commit hash and a passing `doctor --json` on the new build.
verilator.storage: Ignored repository prefix workdir/tools/verilator/v5.052 with its own installation.json provenance, or any operator prefix on PATH; nothing is vendored or redistributed

install.apt: sudo apt-get install -y git help2man perl python3 make autoconf g++ flex bison ccache libfl2 libfl-dev libgoogle-perftools-dev numactl perl-doc zlib1g zlib1g-dev liblz4-dev
install.apt_note: liblz4-dev: Verilator 5.052 compiles its FST writer against the system lz4.h and links -llz4 for every --trace-fst build; zlib1g-dev serves the same writer
install.clone: git clone --depth 1 --branch v5.052 https://github.com/verilator/verilator.git && git -C verilator rev-parse HEAD must equal this pin's commit
install.build: cd verilator && unset VERILATOR_ROOT && autoconf && ./configure --prefix=<prefix> && make -j$(nproc) && make install
install.build_note: `tools verilator` runs exactly these steps as argv into workdir/tools/verilator/v5.052; run them by hand only for an operator prefix outside the repository
install.verify: <prefix>/bin/verilator --version prints 'Verilator 5.052 2026-09-05 rev v5.052'; then python3 tools/build.py doctor --json, which finds the pinned prefix with no PATH edit, or doctor --verilator-bin <prefix>/bin --json for an operator prefix

verilator.runtime: g++ 13 or newer, GNU make, perl, help2man and the lz4/zlib development headers from the same apt line; Verilator consults no license file or environment variable
